# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 2: Maritime Warfare, Letters of Marque, Strait Toll CBs & 5 Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_). Generated by gen_v125_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True if the country owns any of the 10 verified locations guarding the six great world straits:
# Bosphorus/Dardanelles, Gibraltar, Malacca, Oresund (Sound), Hormuz, and Bab el-Mandeb.
oe_nav2_controls_major_strait = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:constantinople
		owns = location:gallipoli
		owns = location:gibraltar
		owns = location:ceuta
		owns = location:malacca
		owns = location:temasek
		owns = location:kobenhavn
		owns = location:helsingor
		owns = location:hormuz
		owns = location:adan
	}
}

# Country scope. True if the country actively licenses privateers or operates as a pirate/naval polity.
oe_nav2_is_pirate_entity = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active
		has_reform = government_reform:pirate_brethren_reform
		country_type = navy
	}
}

# Location scope. True for ocean-accessible ports (excludes landlocked Caspian Sea ports).
oe_nav2_is_ocean_port = {
	is_port = yes
	NOT = { area = area:astrakhan_area }
	NOT = { area = area:shirvan_area }
	NOT = { area = area:mazandaran_area }
	NOT = { region = region:khorasan_region }
}

# Location scope. True for overland Eurasian/Egyptian mainland locations (excludes disconnected islands for land routes).
oe_nav2_is_mainland_eurasia_location = {
	is_land = yes
	OR = {
		continent = continent:europe
		continent = continent:asia
		region = region:egypt_region
	}
	NOT = { region = region:great_britain_region }
	NOT = { region = region:ireland_region }
	NOT = { region = region:japan_region }
	NOT = { region = region:indonesia_region }
	NOT = { region = region:north_atlantic_islands_region }
	NOT = { region = region:macaronesia_region }
}

# Location scope. True for North/West African land locations able to dispatch an overland Western Sahara caravan.
oe_nav2_is_sahara_caravan_origin = {
	is_land = yes
	OR = {
		region = region:maghreb_region
		region = region:egypt_region
		region = region:sahel_region
		region = region:guinea_region
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Expedition 1: Northeast Arctic & Mangazeya Passage (Age 3+).
oe_nav2_eligible_arctic_expedition = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
	has_non_rural_port = yes
	OR = {
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				continent = continent:europe
				region = region:west_siberia_region
				region = region:ural_region
			}
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			oe_nav2_is_ocean_port = yes
			OR = {
				continent = continent:europe
				region = region:west_siberia_region
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Expedition 2: Indian Ocean Treasure Fleet Mission (Age 2-5, non-overlapping with vanilla Ming voyage).
oe_nav2_eligible_indian_ocean_treasure = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { current_age = age_1_traditions }
	NOT = { current_age = age_6_revolutions }
	NOT = { has_cooldown = treasure_fleet_cooldown }
	has_non_rural_port = yes
	any_owned_location = {
		oe_nav2_is_ocean_port = yes
		OR = {
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_africa
			sub_continent = sub_continent:north_africa
			region = region:balkan_region
			region = region:italy_region
			region = region:iberia_region
			region = region:france_region
			region = region:anatolia_region
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when the Indian Ocean Treasure Fleet sails East -> West (East/SE Asian base).
oe_nav2_is_eastern_treasure_origin = {
	capital ?= {
		OR = {
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
			sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Expedition 3: Western Sahara Gold & Sankore Caravan (Age 1-4, African overland foothold).
oe_nav2_eligible_saharan_caravan = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { current_age = age_5_absolutism }
	NOT = { current_age = age_6_revolutions }
	any_owned_location = {
		oe_nav2_is_sahara_caravan_origin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Expedition 4: Silk Road Overland Diplomatic Mission (Age 1-5, mainland Eurasian power).
oe_nav2_eligible_silk_road_embassy = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { current_age = age_6_revolutions }
	num_locations >= 8
	any_owned_location = {
		oe_nav2_is_mainland_eurasia_location = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. True when the Silk Road Embassy departs East -> West (East Asian / Steppe-Mongol base).
oe_nav2_is_eastern_silk_origin = {
	capital ?= {
		OR = {
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
			region = region:mongolia_region
			region = region:manchuria_region
			region = region:tibet_region
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligibility for Expedition 5: Enlightenment Scientific & Classical Survey (Age 5-6).
oe_nav2_eligible_enlightenment_survey = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
	OR = {
		has_ports = yes
		num_locations >= 5
	}
}
